description.value: Fred's is a modern Italian kitchen owned and operated by Catalog Hospitality, with three BC locations including this Kitsilano outpost on the popular West 4th cycling corridor. The kitchen is known for handmade pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and a daily aperitivo hour, with a menu that spans starters, sandwiches, and mains. Cyclists riding the Arbutus Greenway or the West 4th corridor will find it a well-placed sit-down option with a broad menu including multiple plant-based and gluten-free choices.
